# Algorithmics

> > International after-school programming school for children ages 5-17 operating a global franchise model with 300+ partner locations across Europe and beyond.

Algorithmics is a STEM education franchise that combines coding curriculum with a robust business partnership model. The platform serves both individual franchisees and institutional school partners seeking to integrate programming education into their offerings.
